title: Unubahe language
description: Austronesian language spoken in Papua New Guinea
extract: Unubahe (Unuba'e) is a nearly extinct Oceanic language spoken at the southeastern tip of Papua New Guinea. Although a few children speak it, in 2001 there was only one married couple who both spoke the language.
